planning.title: Address and site preparation
planning.body: For multiple locations, we coordinate deliveries, access and handover with the contact at each property.

planning.title: Conditions for external work
planning.body: We schedule roofing, grounds and other outdoor work around weather, materials and access.

faq.question: Can work be planned around restaurant or visitor-venue trading hours?
faq.answer: Yes. We stage work around trading hours, bookings and events, and confirm access and dates in advance.

faq.question: How is outdoor work on the Peninsula scheduled?
faq.answer: We schedule outdoor work around the location, the materials and the weather. We confirm how we’ll access the area before the visit.

faq.question: Can industrial premises and trading venues be included in the same enquiry?
faq.answer: Yes. We group the work by site and property use, then coordinate the trades and access across your locations.

cta.title: Plan your Frankston or Peninsula maintenance
cta.body: Send the address, maintenance list and trading hours so we can plan the order of work.
